fields.Name: T105 - Knowledge Hub Feature Pipelines
fields.Description: Opens the Knowledge Hub Feature Pipelines screen once, then walks the list + client-side search and the pipeline editor dialog, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T259, T260.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Feature Pipelines' in the left nav (fa-diagram-project icon). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Then walk these surfaces IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) pipelines-list-search — confirm the pipelines screen renders as a card grid (each card showing target entity, output attribute, last-run status, and Run/Edit buttons) OR a clear empty-state inviting you to create a pipeline, then type into the 'Search by name, entity, or attribute…' box and confirm the card grid narrows to matching pipelines (or shows a 'No matching pipelines' state); (2) pipeline-editor-dialog — click the primary '+ New Pipeline' button in the header (or the 'Edit' button on an existing pipeline card) and confirm a modal dialog titled 'Feature Pipeline' opens containing the record-process editor form (you do NOT need to save); confirm it can be cancelled/closed. Keep going until both are done.

checkpoints.name: pipelines-list-search
visualCriteria: The Feature Pipelines screen renders a pipeline card grid OR a valid 'No feature pipelines yet' empty state, and typing in the search box narrows the cards to matches OR shows a 'No matching pipelines' no-results state

checkpoints.name: pipeline-editor-dialog
visualCriteria: Clicking New Pipeline (or Edit on a card) opens a 'Feature Pipeline' modal dialog containing the record-process editor, and it can be closed/cancelled without error
